mapper.select: select id, exam_id, student_id, dept_id, class_info, total_score, theory_score, tech_score, status, start_time, deadline_time, auto_submit, submit_time from biz_county_exam_student where exam_id = #{examId} and student_id = #{studentId}

select id, exam_id, student_id, dept_id, class_info, total_score, theory_score, tech_score, status, start_time, deadline_time, auto_submit, submit_time from biz_county_exam_student where exam_id = #{examId} order by dept_id asc, class_info asc, student_id asc

select id, exam_id, student_id, dept_id, class_info, total_score, theory_score, tech_score, status, start_time, deadline_time, auto_submit, submit_time from biz_county_exam_student where exam_id = #{examId}

select dept_id, count(*) as studentCount, avg(total_score) as avgScore, max(total_score) as maxScore, min(total_score) as minScore from biz_county_exam_student where exam_id = #{examId} and status = '1' group by dept_id

select c.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, group_concat(distinct concat(c.entry_year, '级', c.class_code, '班') order by c.entry_year asc, c.class_code asc separator '、') as classInfo, ifnull(stats.studentCount, 0) as studentCount, ifnull(stats.avgScore, 0) as avgScore, ifnull(stats.maxScore, 0) as maxScore, ifnull(stats.minScore, 0) as minScore, ifnull(stats.passCount, 0) as passCount, case when ifnull(stats.studentCount, 0) > 0 then round(ifnull(stats.passCount, 0) * 100 / stats.studentCount, 1) else 0 end as passRate from biz_county_exam_class c left join sys_dept d on c.dept_id = d.dept_id left join ( select st.dept_id, count(1) as studentCount, round(avg(ifnull(st.total_score, 0)), 1) as avgScore, max(ifnull(st.total_score, 0)) as maxScore, min(ifnull(st.total_score, 0)) as minScore, sum(case when ifnull(st.total_score, 0) >= 60 then 1 else 0 end) as passCount from biz_county_exam_student st where st.exam_id = #{examId} group by st.dept_id ) stats on stats.dept_id = c.dept_id where c.exam_id = #{examId} group by c.dept_id, d.dept_name, stats.studentCount, stats.avgScore, stats.maxScore, stats.minScore, stats.passCount order by ifnull(stats.avgScore, 0) desc, deptName asc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_county_exam_student (exam_id, student_id, dept_id, class_info, total_score, theory_score, tech_score, status, start_time, deadline_time, auto_submit, submit_time) values (#{examId}, #{studentId}, #{deptId}, #{classInfo}, #{totalScore}, #{theoryScore}, #{techScore}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{deadlineTime}, #{autoSubmit}, #{submitTime})

insert ignore into biz_county_exam_student (exam_id, student_id, dept_id, class_info, total_score, theory_score, tech_score, status, start_time, deadline_time, auto_submit, submit_time) values (#{examId}, #{studentId}, #{deptId}, #{classInfo}, #{totalScore}, #{theoryScore}, #{techScore}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{deadlineTime}, #{autoSubmit}, #{submitTime})
